experiment_conditions.strategy_family: Moving-average cross, long if short MA > long MA, short if short MA < long MA
experiment_conditions.entry_timing: Signal at confirmed close; execution at next bar open
experiment_conditions.position_rule: Single position; long/short; reverse on opposite signal; re-enter allowed after SL/TP on next bar
experiment_conditions.intrabar_sl_tp_rule: If both SL and TP are touched in one bar, stop-loss is prioritized conservatively
experiment_conditions.transaction_cost: Round trip 1.0 pip; side cost 0.0050 JPY

data_quality_full.note: Forex weekend/holiday gaps are counted as gaps; no interpolation was applied.

data_quality_experiment.note: Forex weekend/holiday gaps are counted as gaps; no interpolation was applied.
